svg.title: hashtally at a glance
svg.desc: Rows of (hash, time) from a fingerprinter are added to a catalog of immutable segments with a liveness table; a search turns hashes shared with a query into votes and votes into candidates. Catalogs are written to checksummed snapshots and read or memory-mapped back; any number of threads search one catalog, each with its own scratch.
svg.text: Rows from a fingerprinter go into a catalog of immutable segments; a search turns shared hashes into votes, and votes into candidates.
CatalogBuilder bulk: radix sort on every core
Catalog::add(rows) one reference at a time → its id
Segments, largest first, each under half the one before
each an Arc<Segment> with its id range and a flag:
segment = keys · directory · packed refs and times (figure 2)
A query: a clip's rows grouped
by hash, at most 64 times each
std; mapping needs the mmap feature
Every load checks the checksum and the structure before use and
rebuilds the directory from the keys (figure 4).
* 1.94 GiB real catalog, AWS m7i-flex.large, huge pages
Catalog is Send + Sync; searches take &self
searched by every thread at once
Scratch: 4 bytes and a bit per id, reused; after the first
